description_en: Queries the resource sharing invitations that you have received
description_zh: 资源使用者调用ListResourceShareInvitations查询自己收到的资源共享邀请信息
kebab_example: aliyun resourcesharing list-resource-share-invitations --max-results 20 --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --resource-share-ids rs-ysGRci9z0000 --resource-share-invitation-ids i-p6eRytrkjVvM0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceShareInvitations

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and retrieve the remaining entries
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resource shares
parameters.name: resource_share_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resource sharing invitations
parameters.name: resource_share_invitation_ids

Unavailable: The resource cannot be shared.

LimitExceeded: The number of shared resources within the Alibaba Cloud account exceeds the upper limit.

ZonalResourceInaccessible: The resource is inaccessible in this region.

InternalError: An internal error occurred on the server during the check.

UnsupportedOperation: The operation is not supported

Status.description_en:
The status of the invitation. Valid values:

Pending: The invitation is pending confirmation.

Accepted: The invitation is accepted.

Cancelled: The invitation is canceled.

Rejected: The invitation is rejected.

Expired: The invitation is expired.

AcceptFailed: The invitation failed to be accepted
